programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

Der 5793 Meter lange Rundkurs wird 53 Mal umfahren, was einer Renndistanz von 306,72 Kilometern entspricht. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Hockey to LED - league of the first / Hokej na ledu - Liga prvaka

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world's NFL was founded in 1920. years, but only by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, today's version of the competition was created. 32 teams divided into two conferences in the league. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams conferences enter the playoffs to the big final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Love on the tip of the fingers / Любов на върха на пръстите
programme.desc: The 50s of the 20th century. Women emancipate themselves and everyone's dream is to be a secretary. Rose Pamfil learns to write on a typewriter and apply for the place of a secretary in the young bachelor Louis Eshar, who has an insurance agency. Rose won the place in difficult competition. Although there is an attraction between Eshar and Rose, they do not indulge in their feelings, and Eshar begins to train a Rose for a quick typewriting race. And Rose goes far away - all the way to the New York World Cup ... / 50-те години на 20 век. Жените се еманципират и мечтата на всяка е да бъде секретарка. Роз Памфил се научава да пише на пишеща машина и кандидатства за мястото на секретарка при младия ерген Луи Ешар, който има застрахователна агенция. Роз спечелва мястото при трудна конкуренция. Въпреки че между Ешар и Роз има привличане, те не се отдават на чувствата си, а Ешар започва да тренира Роз за състезание по бърз машинопис. И Роз стига далече – чак до световно първенство в Ню Йорк…

programme.title: Bandit / Бандит
programme.desc: The true story of the greatest bank robber in Canada history. He was captured in 1988 after years of persecution and after 59 successful robbery. The value of the raised amounts to 2 million and 339 thousand. Police forces unite and organize actions that lead to numerous arrests. Gilbert Galvan - Jr. was originally condemned in the United States, but fleeing the correctional center and ends up in Canada. He initially wants to work to support himself, but soon realizes that there are no armed guards in the banks and begins to do robberies. She meets Andrea and marries her. To secure his family, he begins with robberies. It connects to a local mafia - Tommy Kay. He changed his name to Robert Whitman. He was released from prison in 2001. In 1992, police also detained Ne and he was serving for eight years. / Истинската история на най-големия обирджия на банки в историята на Канада. Той е заловен през 1988 година след години преследвания и след 59 успешни обира. Стойността на задигнатите възлиза на 2 милиона и 339 хиляди. Полицейските сили се обединяват и организират акции, които водят до многобройни арести. Гилбърт Галван – младши е осъден първоначално в САЩ, но бяга от поправителния център и се озовава в Канада. Там първоначално иска да работи, за да се издържа, но скоро разбира, че в Канада в банките няма въоръжена охрана и започва да прави обири. Среща Андреа и се жени за нея. За да осигури семейството си, започва с обирите. Свързва се с местен мафиот – Томи Кей. Сменил е името си на Робърт Уайтмън. Излиза от затвора през 2001 година. През 1992 г. полицията задържа и Томи Ней и той излежава осем години.

programme.title: Bandit / Бандит
programme.desc: The true story of the greatest bank robber in Canada history. He was captured in 1988 after years of persecution and after 59 successful robbery. The value of the raised amounts to 2 million and 339 thousand. Police forces unite and organize actions that lead to numerous arrests. Gilbert Galvan - Jr. was originally condemned in the United States, but fleeing the correctional center and ends up in Canada. He initially wants to work to support himself, but soon realizes that there are no armed guards in the banks and begins to do robberies. She meets Andrea and marries her. To secure his family, he begins with robberies. It connects to a local mafia - Tommy Kay. He changed his name to Robert Whitman. He was released from prison in 2001. In 1992, police also detained Ne and he was serving for eight years. / Истинската история на най-големия обирджия на банки в историята на Канада. Той е заловен през 1988 година след години преследвания и след 59 успешни обира. Стойността на задигнатите възлиза на 2 милиона и 339 хиляди. Полицейските сили се обединяват и организират акции, които водят до многобройни арести. Гилбърт Галван – младши е осъден първоначално в САЩ, но бяга от поправителния център и се озовава в Канада. Там първоначално иска да работи, за да се издържа, но скоро разбира, че в Канада в банките няма въоръжена охрана и започва да прави обири. Среща Андреа и се жени за нея. За да осигури семейството си, започва с обирите. Свързва се с местен мафиот – Томи Кей. Сменил е името си на Робърт Уайтмън. Излиза от затвора през 2001 година. През 1992 г. полицията задържа и Томи Ней и той излежава осем години.

programme.title: Sirenina priča
programme.desc: Contemporary fairy tale, the story of Ryan, a 12-year-old girl who is forced to move with Matt, her father, with the artisy grandfather Alan to the dilapidated fishing town where she was born. As he tries to fit in, he finds new friends and reveals a secret bay, Dom Dolphin and Coral, a mysterious girl. After befriends, Ryan learns that Coral Siren is, and together they come to know the secret that will help girls to save the city. / Suvremena bajka, priča o Ryan, 12-godišnjoj djevojčici koja je prisiljena preseliti se s Mattom, njenim ocem, kod čangrizavog djeda Alana u oronuli ribarski gradić gdje je rođena. Kako se pokušava uklopiti, pronalazi nove prijatelje i otkriva tajnu uvalu, dom delfina i Coral, misteriozne djevojke. Nakon što se sprijatelje, Ryan saznaje da je Coral sirena, a one zajedno spoznaju tajnu koja će pomoći djevojkama da spase grad.

programme.title: De Gaulle
programme.desc: Paris, June 1940. The couple de Gaulle faced the military and political collapse of France. Charles de Gaulle lobby in London while his wife Yvonne and their three children are on the path of refugees. / Pariz, lipanj 1940. Par de Gaulle suočen je s vojnim i političkim kolapsom Francuske. programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty shootout if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: (U -19): Croatia - Czech Republic, Football, Friendly Match / (U-19): Hrvatska - Češka, Nogomet, Prijateljska utakmica
programme.desc: Football: Club Friendly - (Sport. Program, 2025) club seasons in most of the world leagues are divided by two parts, autumn and spring. At the time of summer and winter, the clubs are in the preparatory period and complement the difficult rhythm of training by playing preparatory friendly matches. Friendly meetings are a great way to test the current team of teams and temptation of different tactical variants for the upcoming official matches. Also, they are an opportunity for younger non -affirmed players from the second plan to impose themselves with a professional frame. In friendly meetings, the emphasis is on Fair Play and coaches are allowed to make an unlimited number of changes ... / Football: Club Friendly - (sport. program, 2025) Klupske sezone u većini svjetskih liga podijeljene su dva dijela, jesenski i proljetni. U vrijeme ljeta i zime klubovi su u pripremnom razdoblju te težak ritam treninga upotpunjuju odigravanjem pripremnih prijateljskih utakmica. Prijateljski susreti odličan su način za ispitivanje trenutne snage momčadi i iskušavanje različitih taktičkih varijanti za nadolazeće službene utakmice. Također, prilika su za mlađe neafirmirane igrače iz drugog plana za nametnuti se stručnom kadru. U prijateljskim susretima naglasak je na fair playu te je trenerima dozvoljeno napraviti neograničeni broj izmjena...

programme.title: Nogomet
programme.desc: Football: Club Friendly - (Sport. Program, 2025) club seasons in most of the world leagues are divided by two parts, autumn and spring. At the time of summer and winter, the clubs are in the preparatory period and complement the difficult rhythm of training by playing preparatory friendly matches. Friendly meetings are a great way to test the current team of teams and temptation of different tactical variants for the upcoming official matches. Also, they are an opportunity for younger non -affirmed players from the second plan to impose themselves with a professional frame. In friendly meetings, the emphasis is on Fair Play and coaches are allowed to make an unlimited number of changes ... / Football: Club Friendly - (sport. program, 2025) Klupske sezone u većini svjetskih liga podijeljene su dva dijela, jesenski i proljetni. U vrijeme ljeta i zime klubovi su u pripremnom razdoblju te težak ritam treninga upotpunjuju odigravanjem pripremnih prijateljskih utakmica. Prijateljski susreti odličan su način za ispitivanje trenutne snage momčadi i iskušavanje različitih taktičkih varijanti za nadolazeće službene utakmice. Također, prilika su za mlađe neafirmirane igrače iz drugog plana za nametnuti se stručnom kadru. U prijateljskim susretima naglasak je na fair playu te je trenerima dozvoljeno napraviti neograničeni broj izmjena...

The fire rollers move quickly and block Fionas Group the escape route. The collapseing staircase threatens to become a dead end, but Fiona bravely takes the fuß. programme.title: Quarks im Ersten
programme.sub-title: Stable surface - why we often overlook the meaning of the soil / Stabiler Untergrund - warum wir die Bedeutung des Bodens oft ubersehen
programme.desc: For most people, everyday life mainly takes place over the earth. We rarely move deeper than in the home basement. The soil is much more important than expected: as a diverse ecosystem and memory for nose materials, moisture and CO2. As the basis for agriculture and our food. As a reservoir for valuable raw materials. And as a place where we can store things underground. But although the soil is so crucial for all of us, it is often underestimated. Thomas Ranft takes us down into the ground and explores what happens under the surface of Germany. Why is our favorite earth fruit - the potato - threatened and how is it possible to continue growing with us in the future? What role do rainworm play when it comes to the floor quality. What do you find deep below the earth's surface? And how deep can we dig at all? / Fur die meisten Menschen findet der Alltag vor allem uber der Erde statt. Tiefer als in den heimischen Keller bewegen wir uns nur selten. Dabei ist der Boden unter unseren FuSSen viel wichtiger als gedacht: Als vielfaltiges Ökosystem und Speicher fur Nahrstoffe, Feuchtigkeit und Co2. Als Grundlage fur den Ackerbau und unsere Lebensmittel. Als Reservoir fur wertvolle Rohstoffe. Und als Ort, wo wir Dinge unterirdisch lagern konnen. Doch obwohl der Boden so entscheidend fur uns alle ist, wird er vielfach unterschatzt.Thomas Ranft nimmt uns mit hinab ins Erdreich und erkundet, was unter der Oberflache Deutschlands passiert.Warum wird der Boden manchmal instabil, so dass er ins Rutschen kommt oder gefahrliche Erdlocher entstehen? Warum ist unsere liebste Erdfrucht - die Kartoffel - bedroht und wie gelingt es, sie auch in Zukunft noch bei uns anbauen? Welche Rolle spielen Regenwurmer, wenn es um die Bodenqualitat geht. Was findet man alles tief unter der Erdoberflache? Und wie tief konnen wir uberhaupt graben?

programme.title: Duck good! Madchen alone at home / Ente gut! Madchen allein zu Haus
programme.desc: When Linh's mother has to travel to Vietnam, Linh already knows what to expect. It is not the first time that she stays alone in Germany with her little sister. She has to swing everyday life, help in the family's snack and take care that Tien does not hit the strange - and that the mother's absence is not relieved of anyone. In an emergency, she can contact the Vietnamese community. She will already overcome time - as always, without noticing the school or youth welfare office, but this time everything will be much more difficult. Because the self -proclaimed spy Pauline, who observes the entire quarter from the high -rise building, has his sights. One evening Pauline lurks. She discovered the secret of the Thuys and threatens to remove it. First she demands money for it, then the wild redhead is the demand: she wants to participate in Linh's "exciting life" and cause everything that Linh may. Linh does not understand: she is not allowed to do anything - she has to. Shopping, cooking, getting up. Pauline has no idea how exhausting Linh's life is as a sole responsible! But Pauline is completely opened: Linh does not see what it has for possibilities? Not only because Pauline gets into the Vietnamese community and turns Linh's routine upside down. But also because the little tits becomes more and more uncontrollable the more Pauline and Linh. Because when Pauline understands the pressure under which Linh is, your attitude is different. She not only helps Linh to cover up her secret and dizzys her out of dangerous situations, but turns Linh's nervous everyday life into something beautiful and exciting. She supports Linh in experiencing her first love and lets the snack bar of the Thuys become a magical switch for the entire neighborhood. The initial blackmail becomes an excessive friendship, but the little Tien, who already suffers very from the absence of the mother, is now leaving, since Linh has a friend for the first time. Tien is always wilder, hunt the school and even steal. The youth welfare office becomes aware of the two Vietnamese girls. Linh threatens to grow over the head and Pauline's help will soon no longer be able to preserve it from a discovery. But in the end it is not at all that brings the barrel overflow, but Linh itself - and the situation is pouring threatening. / Als Linhs Mutter nach Vietnam reisen muss, weiSS Linh schon, was auf sie zukommt. Es ist nicht das erste Mal, dass sie mit ihrer kleinen Schwester Tien allein in Deutschland bleibt. Sie muss den Alltag schaukeln, im Imbiss der Familie helfen und dafur sorgen, dass Tien nicht uber die Strange schlagt - und dass die Abwesenheit der Mutter niemandem auffallt. Im Notfall kann sie sich an die vietnamesische Community wenden. Sie wird die Zeit schon uberstehen - wie immer, ohne dass Schule oder Jugendamt etwas bemerken.Doch diesmal wird alles viel schwieriger. Denn die selbsternannte Spionin Pauline, die vom Hochhaus gegenuber das ganze Viertel beobachtet, hat die Thuys im Visier. Eines Abends lauert Pauline Linh auf. Sie hat das Geheimnis der Thuys entdeckt und droht, es zu enthullen. Erst verlangt sie Geld dafur, dann andert der wilde Rotschopf die Forderung: Sie will an Linhs "aufregendem Leben" teilhaben und alles tun durfen, was Linh darf. Linh versteht nicht: Sie darf nichts - sie muss. Einkaufen, Kochen, Aufraumen. Pauline ahnt nicht, wie anstrengend Linhs Leben als Alleinverantwortliche ist! Doch Pauline ist vollig aufgedreht: Sieht Linh gar nicht, was fur Moglichkeiten sie hat?!Nachdem Pauline in ihr Leben geplatzt ist, wird der Alltag der Thuys turbulent - und gefahrlich. Nicht nur, weil Pauline sich in die vietnamesische Community drangt und Linhs Routine auf den Kopf stellt. Sondern auch, weil die kleine Tien immer unkontrollierbarer wird, je mehr Pauline und Linh sich annahern. Denn als Pauline begreift, unter welchem Druck Linh steht, andert sich ihre Haltung. Sie hilft Linh nicht nur bei der Vertuschung ihres Geheimnisses und schwindelt sie aus brenzligen Situationen heraus, sondern verwandelt Linhs nervenzehrenden Alltag in etwas Schones und Aufregendes. Sie unterstutzt Linh darin, ihre erste Liebe zu erleben und lasst die Imbissbude der Thuys zu einer magischen Schaltstelle fur das ganze Viertel werden. Aus der anfanglichen Erpressung wird eine auSSergewohnliche Freundschaft.Doch die kleine Tien, die ohnehin sehr unter der Abwesenheit der Mutter leidet, fuhlt sich nun, da Linh zum ersten Mal eine Freundin hat, ganzlich verlassen. Tien treibt es immer wilder, schwanzt die Schule und klaut sogar. Das Jugendamt wird auf die beiden vietnamesischen Madchen aufmerksam. Linh droht alles uber den Kopf zu wachsen und auch Paulines Hilfe wird sie bald nicht mehr vor einer Entdeckung bewahren konnen. Doch letztlich ist es gar nicht Tien, die das Fass zum Überlaufen bringt, sondern Linh selbst - und die Situation spitzt sich bedrohlich zu.

programme.title: Soldier No. 1 - The General and the turn of the times / Soldat Nr. 1 - Der General und die Zeitenwende
programme.desc: The fact that Russia is preparing for a big conflict with NATO has been heard again and again for months. Carsten Breuer, General Inspector of the Bundeswehr, is the top soldier in Germany, probably the most impressive reminder: In a few years, he says, Russia is ready for a military conflict with the West. How does the Bundeswehr arise against this possible threat? What role does the general inspector play? The ARD journalist Willem Konrad and Lucas Stratmann has succeeded in accompanying Carsten Breuer with her camera for over nine months-for a conversation with Federal President Frank-Walter Steinmeier (SPD), while traveling to the Sudlibanon, Ukraine and the USA. The result is a portrait of the federal government's highest military advisor with deep insights into the German security apparatus. Carsten Breuer redefines the role of the general inspector of the interface between military and politics. Unlike his events, he is looking for the public to place his messages: in detailed newspaper interviews, in talk shows, in a conversation with burgers. Bundeswehr and society had to be warming, a term that comes from his pen and is often quoted, because of this? In Germany, Horbar will be long voices, which are concerned about an escalation with Russia and who have a skepticism in Germany. How does Breuer evaluate the criticism and the desire for more diplomatic means? The Bundeswehr rehearses the defense case in Lithuania in the NATO network. By 2027, a German brigade is to grow to a good 5000 soldiers - to deterrent against Russia. In mid -May, General Breuer will receive a military briefing over the current enemy and inspects the militaries from the hatch of the Guardian tank Puma. The exercise is suddenly interrupted, militar radio is parked. A Russian clearing aircraft was apparently seen in the airspace over the exercise. Intermediate trap like this has been in the past few months. Cyber ​​attacks, sabotage to military facilities, destroyed submarines and drone superfluge - all of this is Putin's tests to test defense and resilience, says Breuer. Because from the Russian perspective there is a long war with the West. The "Ard Story" accompanies a man who has so far had to prepare the Bundeswehr for possible seriousness almost unnoticed by the public. Who is the man who depends on so much and what role does he play for Germany? / Dass Russland sich auf einen groSSen Konflikt mit der NATO vorbereitet, ist seit Monaten immer wieder zu horen. Carsten Breuer, Generalinspekteur der Bundeswehr, ist als oberster Soldat Deutschlands der wohl eindrucklichste Mahner: Bereits in wenigen Jahren, so sagt er, sei Russland bereit fur einen militarischen Konflikt mit dem Westen. Wie stellt sich die Bundeswehr gegen diese mogliche Bedrohung auf? Welche Rolle spielt dabei der Generalinspekteur?Den ARD-Journalisten Willem Konrad und Lucas Stratmann ist es gelungen, Carsten Breuer uber neun Monate exklusiv mit ihrer Kamera zu begleiten - zum Gesprach mit Bundesprasident Frank-Walter Steinmeier (SPD), auf Reisen in den Sudlibanon, die Ukraine und die USA. Entstanden ist ein Portrat des obersten militarischen Beraters der Bundesregierung mit tiefen Einblicken in den deutschen Sicherheitsapparat.An der Schnittstelle zwischen Militar und Politik definiert Carsten Breuer die Rolle des Generalinspekteurs neu. Anders als seine Vorganger sucht er die Öffentlichkeit, um seine Botschaften zu platzieren: in ausfuhrlichen Zeitungsinterviews, in Talkshows, im Gesprach mit Burgern. Bundeswehr und Gesellschaft mussten kriegstuchtig werden, ein Begriff, der mit aus seiner Feder stammt und oft zitiert wird.Doch gehen da alle mit? In Deutschland werden langst Stimmen horbar, die sich vor einer Eskalation mit Russland sorgen und die Aufrustung in Deutschland mit Skepsis beaugen. Wie bewertet Breuer die Kritik und den Wunsch nach mehr diplomatischen Mitteln?Wahrenddessen probt die Bundeswehr im NATO-Verbund den Verteidigungsfall in Litauen. Bis 2027 soll dort eine deutsche Brigade auf gut 5000 Soldatinnen und Soldaten anwachsen - zur Abschreckung gegen Russland.Im Brigade-Quartier in Vilnius bekommt General Breuer dort Mitte Mai ein militarisches Briefing uber die aktuelle Feindlage und inspiziert die Militarubung aus der Luke des Schutzenpanzers Puma heraus. Plotzlich wird die Übung unterbrochen, der Militarfunk abgestellt. Ein russisches Aufklarungsflugzeug wurde offenbar im Luftraum uber der Übung gesichtet. Zwischenfalle wie dieser haufen sich in den letzten Monaten. Cyberangriffe, Sabotage an Militareinrichtungen, zerstorte Unterseekabel und Drohnenuberfluge - das alles seien Putins Tests, um Verteidigungsfahigkeit und Resilienz zu testen, so Breuer. Denn aus russischer Sicht herrsche langst Krieg mit dem Westen.Die "ARD Story" begleitet einen Mann, der bislang fast unbemerkt von der Öffentlichkeit eher im Hintergrund die Bundeswehr fur mogliche Ernstfalle vorbereiten muss. Wer ist der Mann, von dem so viel abhangt und welche Rolle spielt er fur Deutschland?

programme.title: Utta Danella - a love in Venice / Utta Danella - Eine Liebe in Venedig
programme.desc: The confident, young Munchner Lilly (Denise Zich) is a romantic from conviction. With devotion she repairs old dolls and firmly believes that one day of her great love. When she received the news of the death of her Venetian godfather Gianni, in whom she often spent the vacation as a child, she closes her doll clinic and drive to Italy to the funeral. In the House of the godfather, a winding, picturesquely weathered Palazzo in the heart of Venice, Lilly shocks a supposed burglar who imagines Francesco di Selari (Gedeon Burkhard), a charming hotelier and long -term friend of Giannis. The exchanging is all the more as the exchanges when Francesco also introduces her to his fiance Giovanna (Barbara Livi), an elegant, confident Venetian with whom he has long been lined up. Lilly, deeply injured, decides not to see this Francesco again - but nothing becomes of the intent, because in the testament option she experiences a surprise: the sponsor of his palazzo has been wounding her, the other halen goes to Francesco, who is supposed to be a wealthy hotelier for the maintenance. When her mother Teresa (Gila von Weitershausen) and her father Max (Dieter Kirchlechner) arrive in Venice, Lilly experiences a long healed family secret that finally falter her firmly groomed world. / Die vertraumte, junge Munchnerin Lilly (Denise Zich) ist Romantikerin aus Überzeugung. Mit Hingabe repariert sie alte Puppen und glaubt fest daran, eines Tages ihrer groSSen Liebe zu begegnen. Zwischen beiden funkt es auf Anhieb, und Lilly glaubt schon, dass sie endlich ihren "Mr. Right" gefunden hat. Umso herber ist die Enttauschung, als Francesco ihr beim Essen ganz nebenbei seine Verlobte Giovanna (Barbara Livi) vorstellt, eine elegante, selbstsichere Venezianerin, mit der er seit Langem liiert ist. Wahrend Lilly ratselt, ob Francesco gar Giannis Sohn ist, kommen sich die beiden wieder naher. Doch Lilly hat Skrupel, Francescos Beziehung zu Giovanna zu zerstoren. Als ihre Mutter Teresa (Gila von Weitershausen) und ihr Vater Max (Dieter Kirchlechner) in Venedig eintreffen, erfahrt Lilly ein lange gehutetes Familiengeheimnis, das ihre fest gefugte Welt endgultig ins Wanken bringt.

programme.sub-title: Detergent, fabricate and Co. / Waschmittel, Weichspuler und Co.
programme.desc: Whether fragrance promises, magical "renew" effects or XXL washing machines with a questionable drum size: a current NDR research for the competence center consumers reveals what is behind the marketing tricks of the detergent industry and how consumers are encouraged to buy. Pods and even washing leaves. The manufacturers promise the best washing results for all products. Which really washes best, reveal tests at the Niederrhein University of Applied Sciences. For a long time, detergents should no longer only clean the clothes. The products should also smell good too! Parliamented detergents are often advertised with "aromatherapy" or "deodorant fresh". But warning consumer protection: fragrances are not harmless to health and are critical of the environment in large quantities. Much of what the industry sells as an innovation is not used for clean washing - on the contrary. Interested in particular: detergent ingredients such as phosphonates or river plastics get over clarifiers into the river and can lead to environmental damage there. The latest research even suggests that the controversial glyphosate in waters is partly caused by degradation processes of detergent components. Many rates promise loads with eight, nine or even eleven kilos. But the NDR research shows that machines with identical drum -size, but with different large details, are sold - at different prices and with different energy efficiency labeling. Because when calculating the energy class, manufacturers have scope. Consumer protection demands: The criteria have to be stricter. In "the tricks with detergent, fabricate and Co." Find Anna Planken and Jo Hiller and the editorial team of the NDR: Not everything that smells cleans. And not everything that glows is good for health or environment. Anyone who dispenses with troubles and detergents properly dosed, but also washes more comfortable, but also more sustainable. / Ob Duftversprechen, magische "Renew"-Effekte oder XXL-Waschmaschinen mit fragwurdiger TrommelgroSSe: Eine aktuelle NDR-Recherche fur das Kompetenzcenter Verbraucher deckt auf, was hinter den Marketingtricks der Waschmittelindustrie steckt und wie Verbraucher zum Kaufen animiert werden.Die Produktvielfalt in den Regalen ist riesig: von Flussigwaschmitteln uber Pulver bis hin zu Kapseln, Pods und sogar Waschblattern. Bei allen Produkten versprechen die Hersteller beste Waschergebnisse. Welches wirklich am besten wascht, offenbaren Tests an der Hochschule Niederrhein. Waschmittel sollen allerdings langst nicht mehr nur die Kleidung reinigen. Gut riechen sollen die Produkte auch! Parfumierte Waschmittel werden oft mit "Aromatherapie" oder "Deo-Frische" beworben. Doch Verbraucherschutzer warnen: Duftstoffe sind gesundheitlich nicht unbedenklich und in groSSen Mengen kritisch fur die Umwelt. Vieles, was die Industrie als Innovation verkauft, wird fur saubere Wasche nicht gebraucht - im Gegenteil.Besonders besorgniserregend: Waschmittelinhaltsstoffe wie Phosphonate oder Flussigkunststoffe gelangen uber Klaranlagen in die Flusse und konnen dort zu Umweltschaden fuhren. Neueste Forschungen legen sogar nahe, dass das umstrittene Glyphosat in Gewassern teilweise durch Abbauprozesse von Waschmittelbestandteilen entsteht.Nicht nur bei Waschmitteln, auch bei Waschmaschinen wird getrickst. Viele Gerate versprechen Beladungen mit acht, neun oder sogar elf Kilo Wasche. Doch die NDR-Recherche zeigt: Es werden Maschinen mit identischer TrommelgroSSe, aber mit unterschiedlichen GroSSenangaben verkauft - zu unterschiedlichen Preisen und mit unterschiedlicher Energieeffizienzkennzeichnung. Denn bei der Berechnung der Energieklasse haben Hersteller Spielraum. Verbraucherschutzer fordern: Die Kriterien mussen strenger werden.In "Die Tricks mit Waschmittel, Weichspuler und Co." finden Anna Planken und Jo Hiller sowie das Redaktionsteam des NDR heraus: Nicht alles, was duftet, reinigt auch. Und nicht alles, was glanzt, ist gut fur Gesundheit oder Umwelt. Wer auf uberflussige Zusatze verzichtet und Waschmittel richtig dosiert, wascht nicht nur gunstiger, sondern auch nachhaltiger.

programme.desc: Large quantities of water penetrate into the acute nuclear warehouse of the aces. Operating Fuhrer Guido Oesterreich is faced with a barely relievable task: he is supposed to stop the water with his workforce and also stabilize the broken mine. Otherwise, the radioactive contamination of an entire region threatens. A few decades after this promise, the aces for the unaffected conflicts of nuclear power, the radiant scrap of Germany cannot get rid of. For a year a film team for the "ARD Story" accompanied the miners underground - and in the world it observed the questionable politics for the nuclear lull. For the first time, miners of the aces take a stand in front of the camera in unusual clarity and reveal unknown insights into the terrifying, absurd everyday life of a human task that have left past generations. / In das havarierte Atommulllager der Asse dringen unkontrolliert groSSe Mengen Wasser ein. Betriebsfuhrer Guido Oesterreich steht vor einer kaum losbaren Aufgabe: Er soll mit seiner Belegschaft das Wasser aufhalten und dabei auch noch das bruchige Bergwerk stabilisieren. Sonst droht die radioaktive Kontamination einer ganzen Region.Ein Eisenkorb voller Bergleute rast scheppernd durch die Dunkelheit hinab in die Tiefe: Schachtlager Asse II, ehemaliges Salzbergwerk bei Wolfenbuttel in Niedersachsen. Endlager fur radioaktiven Atommull. Einen halben Kilometer unter der Erde hantieren die Bergleute mit Schlauchen bei 40 Grad Hitze. Bohrgestange drehen sich kreischend in das Salzgestein. Mitten im Larm steht Betriebsfuhrer Guido Oesterreich. Er soll den Wassereinbruch der Asse irgendwie in den Griff bekommen. Diese Aufgabe scheint kaum losbar. Denn das Wasser stromt schon seit Jahren durch zahllose Felsspalten in das Atommulllager. "Bisher konnten wir das eindringende Wasser weiter oben im Berg abpumpen", so Oesterreich. "Doch seit letztem Sommer findet es plotzlich andere Wege und stromt tiefer in den Berg, bis knapp uber die Kammern mit dem Atommull." Erreicht das Wasser den radioaktiven Abfall, droht die Kontamination der ganzen Region. Ein Wettlauf mit der Zeit, bis der Atommull endlich aus der Asse herausgeholt und in ein sicheres Endlager gebracht werden kann.Von 1965 bis 1978 hatte man hier radioaktivem Abfall eingelagert, angeblich zu Forschungszwecken. Am Ende lagen 126.000 verstrahlte Fasser Atommull im Berg vergraben. Und die Betreiber erklarten der Bevolkerung, die Asse sei jetzt ein "ganz besonders sicheres" Endlager. Wenige Jahrzehnte nach diesem Versprechen steht die Asse fur die ungelosten Konflikte der Atomkraft, deren strahlenden Schrott Deutschland nicht loswerden kann.Über ein Jahr lang hat ein Filmteam fur die "ARD Story" die Bergleute unter Tage begleitet - und in der Welt daruber die fragwurdige Politik um den Atommull beobachtet. Zum ersten Mal nehmen Bergleute der Asse in ungewohnter Klarheit Stellung vor der Kamera und offenbaren unbekannte Einblicke in den erschreckenden, absurden Alltag einer Menschheitsaufgabe, die vergangene Generationen ihnen hinterlassen haben.

programme.title: The tricks with ... / Die Tricks mit ...
programme.sub-title: Detergent, fabricate and Co. / Waschmittel, Weichspuler und Co.
programme.desc: Whether fragrance promises, magical "renew" effects or XXL washing machines with a questionable drum size: a current NDR research for the competence center consumers reveals what is behind the marketing tricks of the detergent industry and how consumers are encouraged to buy. Pods and even washing leaves. The manufacturers promise the best washing results for all products. Which really washes best, reveal tests at the Niederrhein University of Applied Sciences. For a long time, detergents should no longer only clean the clothes. The products should also smell good too! Parliamented detergents are often advertised with "aromatherapy" or "deodorant fresh". But warning consumer protection: fragrances are not harmless to health and are critical of the environment in large quantities. Much of what the industry sells as an innovation is not used for clean washing - on the contrary. Interested in particular: detergent ingredients such as phosphonates or river plastics get over clarifiers into the river and can lead to environmental damage there. The latest research even suggests that the controversial glyphosate in waters is partly caused by degradation processes of detergent components. Many rates promise loads with eight, nine or even eleven kilos. But the NDR research shows that machines with identical drum -size, but with different large details, are sold - at different prices and with different energy efficiency labeling. Because when calculating the energy class, manufacturers have scope. Consumer protection demands: The criteria have to be stricter. In "the tricks with detergent, fabricate and Co." Find Anna Planken and Jo Hiller and the editorial team of the NDR: Not everything that smells cleans. And not everything that glows is good for health or environment. Anyone who dispenses with troubles and detergents properly dosed, but also washes more comfortable, but also more sustainable. / Ob Duftversprechen, magische "Renew"-Effekte oder XXL-Waschmaschinen mit fragwurdiger TrommelgroSSe: Eine aktuelle NDR-Recherche fur das Kompetenzcenter Verbraucher deckt auf, was hinter den Marketingtricks der Waschmittelindustrie steckt und wie Verbraucher zum Kaufen animiert werden.Die Produktvielfalt in den Regalen ist riesig: von Flussigwaschmitteln uber Pulver bis hin zu Kapseln, Pods und sogar Waschblattern. Bei allen Produkten versprechen die Hersteller beste Waschergebnisse. Welches wirklich am besten wascht, offenbaren Tests an der Hochschule Niederrhein. Waschmittel sollen allerdings langst nicht mehr nur die Kleidung reinigen. Gut riechen sollen die Produkte auch! Parfumierte Waschmittel werden oft mit "Aromatherapie" oder "Deo-Frische" beworben. Doch Verbraucherschutzer warnen: Duftstoffe sind gesundheitlich nicht unbedenklich und in groSSen Mengen kritisch fur die Umwelt. Vieles, was die Industrie als Innovation verkauft, wird fur saubere Wasche nicht gebraucht - im Gegenteil.Besonders besorgniserregend: Waschmittelinhaltsstoffe wie Phosphonate oder Flussigkunststoffe gelangen uber Klaranlagen in die Flusse und konnen dort zu Umweltschaden fuhren. Neueste Forschungen legen sogar nahe, dass das umstrittene Glyphosat in Gewassern teilweise durch Abbauprozesse von Waschmittelbestandteilen entsteht.Nicht nur bei Waschmitteln, auch bei Waschmaschinen wird getrickst. Viele Gerate versprechen Beladungen mit acht, neun oder sogar elf Kilo Wasche. Doch die NDR-Recherche zeigt: Es werden Maschinen mit identischer TrommelgroSSe, aber mit unterschiedlichen GroSSenangaben verkauft - zu unterschiedlichen Preisen und mit unterschiedlicher Energieeffizienzkennzeichnung. Denn bei der Berechnung der Energieklasse haben Hersteller Spielraum. Verbraucherschutzer fordern: Die Kriterien mussen strenger werden.In "Die Tricks mit Waschmittel, Weichspuler und Co." finden Anna Planken und Jo Hiller sowie das Redaktionsteam des NDR heraus: Nicht alles, was duftet, reinigt auch. Und nicht alles, was glanzt, ist gut fur Gesundheit oder Umwelt. Wer auf uberflussige Zusatze verzichtet und Waschmittel richtig dosiert, wascht nicht nur gunstiger, sondern auch nachhaltiger.

programme.title: Kraftfahrzeug - Eine deutsche Liebe
programme.desc: The car is still fascinated almost 150 years after its history. The number of vehicles in Germany rose to a record high in 2024. Some even worship it as a cult object or see a family member in him. But the car polarizes like hardly any other object. The film explores the emotional relationship between the Germans to the car. The documentary filmmaker Jan Tenhaven meets passionate car lovers and sharp critics: Journalist Ulf Poschardt flashes from the sports car as part of the high culture, mobility expert Katja Diehl questions the status fetish, autodesigner Adrian van Hooydonk explains the aggressive front design, and VDA-Prasident Hildegard defends the car as "Ruckbat of the economy". Car manufacturers provide rare insights into their tricks of emotional proof of the emotional. Large pictures, shrill scenes and surprising insights condense into an entertaining road movie through the Autoland Germany. / Das Auto fasziniert fast 150 Jahre nach seiner Entstehungsgeschichte noch immer. Die Zahl der Fahrzeuge in Deutschland stieg 2024 auf ein Rekordhoch. Manche verehren es gar als Kultobjekt oder sehen in ihm ein Familienmitglied. Doch das Auto polarisiert auch wie kaum ein anderer Gegenstand. Der Film erkundet das emotionale Verhaltnis der Deutschen zum Auto. Dabei trifft der Dokumentarfilmer Jan Tenhaven auf leidenschaftliche Autoliebhaber und scharfe Kritiker: Journalist Ulf Poschardt schwarmt vom Sportwagen als Teil der Hochkultur, Mobilitatsexpertin Katja Diehl hinterfragt den Statusfetisch, Autodesigner Adrian van Hooydonk erklart das aggressive Frontdesign, und VDA-Prasidentin Hildegard Muller verteidigt das Auto als "Ruckgrat der Wirtschaft". Autohersteller geben seltene Einblicke in ihre Tricks der emotionalen Verfuhrung. GroSSe Bilder, schrille Szenen und uberraschende Einsichten verdichten sich zu einem unterhaltsamen Roadmovie durch das Autoland Deutschland.

programme.title: Eco
programme.desc: School start - how much money do good schools need? The new school year has already started in eastern Austria. And now it becomes clear where the teacher is missing, where there are school psychologists and for what measures the school budget is not enough. The Minister of Education is pleased that his ministry does not have to save as much as other areas of the federal government. The educational budget is even increased somewhat - but the majority flows into the salaries with the staff. What do these budget requirements mean for the new school year? Austria is around 14,000 euros per schooler and school year internationally in the top field, but in the PISA test results for math or reading skills, you are only on average. But is it actually needed millions or can be achieved a lot with more efficiency or restructuring? Report: Pia Bichara, Bettina FinkWeififligen - how our bonitat is secretly rated how are we kept? Our bonitat is constantly evaluated by special companies - and hardly anyone knows about it. In addition to the KSV 1870, it is primarily the Bonitatskanzlei "CRIF" that awards so-called creditwurdability scores for private individuals. Most of them are based on "CRIF" only on age, gender and residential address, the data protection officer Max Schrems criticizes. Nevertheless, due to this few data, an evaluation sometimes decides which conditions we tolerate for cell phone, electricity or loans. Which companies rely on this data and what do we can do about it? Report: Gerhard Jansersalle Years again - why in supermarket the Christmas mood will come up with the mood in the summer, vanilla biscuits and Christstollen - which sounds like Advent market, is also a reality in midsummer. Already in mid -August there are the first Christmas sweets in the supermarket shelves. While some are happy, the others are not very enthusiastic. Because gingerbread in August polarize: for some of a early pleasure, for the others an annual annoyance. But who actually sets the tone on this early start to Christmas - the trade, the consumers or the producers? And is the whole thing just an economic calculation - or is there more behind it? Report: Ines Ottenschlager / Schulstart - wie viel Geld brauchen gute Schulen?Das neue Schuljahr hat im Osten Österreichs bereits begonnen. Und jetzt wird klar, wo heuer Lehrer fehlen, wo es genugend Schulpsychologen gibt und fur welche MaSSnahmen das Schulbudget nicht reicht. Der Bildungsminister freut sich, dass sein Ministerium heuer nicht ganz so viel sparen muss, wie andere Bereiche des Bundes. Das Bildungsbudget wird sogar etwas aufgestockt - der GroSSteil flieSSt allerdings in die Gehaltserhohungen beim Personal. Was bedeuten diese Budgetvorgaben fur das neue Schuljahr? Österreich liegt zwar mit rund 14.000 Euro Kosten je Schuler und Schuljahr international im Spitzenfeld, bei den Pisa-Testergebnissen fur Mathe- oder Lesekompetenzen liegt man allerdings nur im guten Durchschnitt. Doch braucht es tatsachlich zusatzliche Millionen oder lasst sich mit mehr Effizienz oder Umstrukturierungen auch viel erreichen? Bericht: Pia Bichara, Bettina FinkZweifelhafte Abfragen - wie unsere Bonitat heimlich bewertet wirdWie kreditwurdig sind wir? Von speziellen Unternehmen wird unsere Bonitat laufend bewertet - und kaum jemand weiSS davon. Neben dem KSV 1870 ist es vor allem die Bonitatskanzlei "CRIF", die so genannte Kreditwurdigkeits-Scores fur Privatpersonen vergibt. Meist basieren diese bei "CRIF" nur auf Alter, Geschlecht und Wohnadresse, kritisiert der Datenschutzer Max Schrems. Trotzdem entscheidet eine Bewertung aufgrund dieser wenigen Daten mitunter, zu welchen Konditionen wir Vertrage fur Handy, Strom oder Kredite bekommen. Welche Unternehmen verlassen sich auf diese Daten und was konnen wir dagegen tun? Bericht: Gerhard JanserAlle Jahre wieder - warum in Supermarkten schon im Sommer Weihnachtsstimmung aufkommtLebkuchen, Vanillekipferl und Christstollen - was nach Adventmarkt klingt, ist langst auch im Hochsommer Realitat. Bereits Mitte August gibt es in den Supermarktregalen die ersten weihnachtlichen Naschereien. Wahrend sich die einen daruber freuen, sind die anderen wenig begeistert. Denn Lebkuchen im August polarisieren: Fur die einen ein vorgezogener Festgenuss, fur die anderen ein alljahrliches Ärgernis. Doch wer gibt eigentlich den Ton an bei diesem fruhen Start in die Weihnachtszeit - der Handel, die Konsumentinnen und Konsumenten oder die Produzenten? Und ist das Ganze nur wirtschaftliches Kalkul - oder steckt mehr dahinter? Bericht: Ines Ottenschlager

programme.title: Hohes Haus

Das hatte der Rechnungshof als unzulassige Parteienfinanzierung kritisiert. Susanne Daubel informiert.-Neue TransparenzSeit 1. September gilt in Österreich die sogenannte Informationsfreiheit. programme.title: It could get worse - Mario Adorf / Es hatte schlimmer kommen konnen - Mario Adorf
programme.desc: On the occasion of Mario Adorf's 95th birthday, the film has so far gained insight into the career, which has been going on for more than 60 years: his private life, his relationships, his view of the world, politics, love and also to get older. Mario Adorf had in 1957 with the film "at night when the devil came" by Robert Siodmak. Since then he has played in over 200 films, including the direction of Billy Wilder, Volker Schlondorff and Rainer Werner Fassbinder. The birth of the Swiss in the Eifel grew up, was in Munche at the Schauspiel School, has lived in Rome for around 30 years and is married to a Frenchman with whom he still commutes between his residence in Paris, Saint Tropez and Munchen. Director Dominik Wessely accompanied Mario Adorf to the different locations and shows him in memories and shows some excerpts from his versatile groyne and film career. The result is a moving portrait of an extraordinary actor and people. / Anlasslich des 95. Geburtstags von Mario Adorf verschafft der Film bislang verborgene Einblicke in die mehr als 60 Jahre andauernde Karriere: sein privates Leben, seine Beziehungen, seine Sicht auf die Welt, die Politik, die Liebe und auch auf das Älterwerden.Seinen internationalen Durchbruch hatte Mario Adorf 1957 mit dem Film "Nachts, wenn der Teufel kam" von Robert Siodmak. Seitdem hat er in uber 200 Filmen gespielt, u.a. unter der Regie von Billy Wilder, Volker Schlondorff und Rainer Werner Fassbinder. Aufgewachsen ist der geburtige Schweizer in der Eifel, war in Munchen an der Schauspiel-Schule, hat rund 30 Jahre lang in Rom gelebt und ist mit einer Franzosin verheiratet, mit der er heute noch zwischen seinen Wohnsitzen in Paris, Saint Tropez und Munchen pendelt.Regisseur Dominik Wessely hat Mario Adorf an die unterschiedlichen Orte begleitet, lasst ihn in Erinnerungen schwelgen und zeigt einige Ausschnitte aus seiner vielseitigen Buhnen- und Film-Karriere. Entstanden ist ein bewegendes Portrat eines auSSergewohnlichen Schauspielers und Menschen.

programme.title: Summer discussion 2025 / Sommergesprache 2025
programme.sub-title: Klaus Webhofer in conversation with Herbert Kickl, FPÖ / Klaus Webhofer im Gesprach mit Herbert Kickl, FPÖ
programme.desc: Domestic policy chief Klaus Webhofer for the first time leads through the interview series. The "Summer Talks 25" with the chairpersons of the parliament represented in the parliament can be seen this year from August 11th to September 8th, every Monday, at 9:00 p.m. in ORF 2 and on ORF ON. The setting for the first time since 2022 is again the ORF media campus on Kuniglberg. In a year of profound political upheaval, Herbert Kickl was about to be the first FPÖ politician to take the office of Chancellor. But after the failure of the government negotiations with the ÖVP, the head of the now most strong parliamentary party remains in opposition. How does Herbert Kickl deal with this turn personally? Which course does he think of with the freedom and which power options are now open to him? Schauplatz ist erstmals seit 2022 wieder der ORF-Mediencampus am Kuniglberg.In einem Jahr tiefgreifender politischer Umbruche stand Herbert Kickl kurz davor, als erster FPÖ-Politiker das Amt des Bundeskanzlers zu ubernehmen. Doch nach dem Scheitern der Regierungsverhandlungen mit der ÖVP bleibt der Chef der mittlerweile starksten Parlamentspartei in Opposition.Wie geht Herbert Kickl personlich mit dieser Wendung um? programme.title: Urban Pulse - the heartbeat of a city / Urban Pulse - Der Herzschlag einer Stadt
programme.desc: The river, the industrial city and its past: This is where the heartbeat of Linz fed. Making Horbar is the claim and motto of the Linz sound cloud this year. In the documentary "Urban Pulse - the heartbeat of a city", this urban rhythm also gets a face. Tens of thousands of people are streaming every year on a Saturday evening in early September in the park on the Danube in the heart of the Upper Eastern Reich state capital. You will attend the acoustic and visual spectacle that the sound cloud has been offering for 45 years. / Der Fluss, die Industriestadt und ihre Vergangenheit: Daraus speist sich der Herzschlag von Linz. Ihn horbar zu machen, ist Anspruch und Motto der diesjahrigen Linzer Klangwolke. In der Dokumentation "Urban Pulse - Der Herzschlag einer Stadt", bekommt dieser urbane Rhythmus auch ein Gesicht. Zehntausende Menschen stromen jedes Jahr an einem Samstagabend Anfang September in den Park an der Donau im Herzen der oberosterreichischen Landeshauptstadt. Sie wohnen dem akustischen und visuellen Schauspiel bei, das die Klangwolke seit 45 Jahren bietet.

programme.desc: Susanne is harassing the staff where she can and makes jerky decisions behind Wenceslaus. programme.title: Wiener Utopien
programme.desc: The "Vienna Utopia" enables a look in the past as well as 100 years into the future. The "unobstructed city" of the past - visualized by digital models - serves as a means to make social current and power conditions visible. For the future, students of the university for applied art strategies to practice the urgent problems of big city. A film by Judith Doppler for the Vienna State Studio / Die "Wiener Utopien" ermoglichen einen Blick sowohl 100 Jahre in die Vergangenheit als auch 100 Jahre in die Zukunft. Die "ungebaute Stadt" der Vergangenheit - visualisiert durch digitale Modelle - dient dabei als Mittel, um gesellschaftliche Stromungen und Machtverhaltnisse sichtbar zu machen. programme.title: 9 Breaks - 9 Schatze: So is Austria / 9 Platze - 9 Schatze: So schon ist Österreich
programme.desc: Vienna shows itself from its earliest side - on a ride with one of the legendary Fiaker we show idyllic and exciting places across the city from downtown: we visit the museum quarters and the Secession, the Naschmarkt and the House of the Sea, the based zoo and the palm house in Schonbrunn, make a detour into the breathtaking church at the stone courtyard and of course. Accompanied by Elisabeth Vogel we drive along the Danube Canal and end our trip to the central cemetery. / Wien zeigt sich von seiner schonsten Seite - auf einer Fahrt mit einem der legendaren Fiaker zeigen wir ausgehend von der Innenstadt idyllische und aufregende Platze quer durch die Stadt: wir besuchen das Museumsquartier und die Secession, den Naschmarkt und das Haus des Meeres, den beruhmten Tiergarten und das Palmenhaus in Schonbrunn, machen einen Abstecher in die atemberaubend schone Kirche am Steinhof und naturlich in den Wurstelprater. Begleitet von Elisabeth Vogel fahren wir am Donaukanal entlang und beenden unseren Ausflug am Zentralfriedhof.

programme.title: Summer discussion 2025 / Sommergesprache 2025
programme.sub-title: Klaus Webhofer in conversation with Herbert Kickl, FPÖ / Klaus Webhofer im Gesprach mit Herbert Kickl, FPÖ
programme.desc: Domestic policy chief Klaus Webhofer for the first time leads through the interview series. The "Summer Talks 25" with the chairpersons of the parliament represented in the parliament can be seen this year from August 11th to September 8th, every Monday, at 9:00 p.m. in ORF 2 and on ORF ON. The setting for the first time since 2022 is again the ORF media campus on Kuniglberg. In a year of profound political upheaval, Herbert Kickl was about to be the first FPÖ politician to take the office of Chancellor. But after the failure of the government negotiations with the ÖVP, the head of the now most strong parliamentary party remains in opposition. How does Herbert Kickl deal with this turn personally? Which course does he think of with the freedom and which power options are now open to him? He has been rare in the media for a long time, now Herbert Kickl faces the ORF summer discussion. / Innenpolitik-Chef Klaus Webhofer fuhrt erstmals durch die Interview-Reihe. Die "Sommergesprache 25" mit den Vorsitzenden der im Parlament vertretenen Fraktionen sind heuer vom 11. August bis zum 8. September, immer montags, um 21.00 Uhr in ORF 2 und auf ORF ON zu sehen. Schauplatz ist erstmals seit 2022 wieder der ORF-Mediencampus am Kuniglberg.In einem Jahr tiefgreifender politischer Umbruche stand Herbert Kickl kurz davor, als erster FPÖ-Politiker das Amt des Bundeskanzlers zu ubernehmen. Doch nach dem Scheitern der Regierungsverhandlungen mit der ÖVP bleibt der Chef der mittlerweile starksten Parlamentspartei in Opposition.Wie geht Herbert Kickl personlich mit dieser Wendung um? Welchen Kurs schlagt er mit den Freiheitlichen ein und welche Machtoptionen stehen ihm nun offen? Lange hat er sich in den Medien rar gemacht, nun stellt sich Herbert Kickl dem ORF-Sommergesprach.

programme.title: Das Pantanal - Brasiliens geheimnisvolle Wasserwelt
programme.desc: Im Sudwesten Brasiliens liegt das groSSte Binnenland-Feuchtgebiet der Erde: das Pantanal. Fast ein halbes Jahr stehen hier dank der ergiebigen Regenzeit tausende Quadratkilometer Land unter Wasser. Der Wechsel zwischen Überschwemmungen und Trockenphasen schuf uber Jahrmillionen ein dichtes Mosaik aus Seen und kleinen Flusslaufen, Waldern und Graslandschaften. Viele, teils seltene Tier- und Pflanzenarten finden in der einzigartigen Tiefebene ein letztes Refugium inmitten von Lebensraumen, die durch Abholzung, Viehzucht und Ackerbau stark in Mitleidenschaft gezogen sind. Hier liegen Jaguare und Pumas auf der Lauer, wahrend Capybaras und Sumpfhirsche im Wasserpflanzenmeer schlemmen. Dazwischen rivalisieren Kaimane mit Riesenottern um die besten Fischgrunde. Himmelblaue Hyazinth-Aras, die groSSten Papageien der Welt, bevolkern lautstark die dichten Baumkronen, unter denen Gurteltiere tiefe Erdbauten graben und Ameisenbaren ihre lange Zunge auf Termitenjagd schicken. Das weitlaufige Paradies hat jedoch eine Achillesferse: es hangt vom Regen ab, der stetig weniger wird…Bearbeitung: Doris Hochmayr

programme.title: kreuz und quer
programme.desc: Is the life path predetermined? Can you struggle with fate - or try to make it merciful? The belief in faith is not uncommon today to take the belief in a personal God - so it shows recent studies on the change in the change of religious attitudes. Does the "belief in fate" have consequences for life design? Does he bring into passive fatalism or to rebel against an anonymous that ultimately predetermined everything? Klaus Steindl went on a search for traces and discovered many old roots. / Ist der Lebensweg vorherbestimmt? Darf man mit dem Schicksal hadern - oder versuchen, es gnadig zu stimmen? An die Stelle des Glaubens an einen personalen Gott tritt heute nicht selten der Glaube an das Schicksal - so zeigen es neuere Untersuchungen zum Wandel religioser Einstellungen. Hat der "Glaube an das Schicksal" Konsequenzen fur die Lebensgestaltung? Fuhrt er in einen passiven Fatalismus oder zur Auflehnung gegen eine anonyme Macht, die letztlich alles vorherbestimmt? Klaus Steindl hat sich auf eine Spurensuche begeben und dabei so manch alte Wurzel entdeckt.

programme.title: kreuz und quer
programme.desc: Security is considered one of the greatest needs and longing for people - and conveys a feel of familiarity and security. And yet the claim is to plan everything in your own life and to be able to predict with certainty. Andrea Eder's film shows people who were also confronted with personal crises in already uncertain times and, despite all the difficulties, were ultimately able to cope with. / Sicherheit gilt als eines der groSSten Bedurfnisse und Sehnsuchte der Menschen - und vermittelt ein Gefuhl der Vertrautheit und Geborgenheit. Und doch ist der Anspruch, im eigenen Leben alles selbst zu planen und mit Sicherheit vorausberechnen zu konnen, eine Illusion. Der Film von Andrea Eder zeigt Menschen, die in ohnehin unsicheren Zeiten auch mit personlichen Krisen konfrontiert waren und diese - trotz aller Schwierigkeiten - letztlich bewaltigen konnten.
